author: Clint Bellanger (clintbellanger.net), building on Kenney's Tiny Dungeon/Tiny Town
attribution_text: Not required (CC0); credited to Clint Bellanger as courtesy
note_on_source_type: unlike every other entry, this source is ALREADY pixel art (a 16x16 CC0 game sprite), not a photo/illustration converted afresh - there is no real-world or public-domain illustration lineage for a D&D-original creature like the owlbear, so a CC0 pixel-art sprite was used and re-processed (recolor-quantized, not just copied) through the same pipeline for consistency

author: Pearson Scott Foresman
bg_removal: lineart_alpha, then multiply-tinted fiery red-orange (rgb 210,60,10) - a real hellhound-specific illustration was tried first and rejected (see below); a plain wolf line-art plus color is the honest substitute, not a fabricated hound

rejected_candidates.candidate: File:Houn-53 - The coal-black Hound (Hound of Baskervilles).jpg, Sidney Paget, 1901, public domain
rejected_candidates.reason: license fine and thematically on point (Conan Doyle's hound is literally described as fire-outlined); rejected only on technical grounds - a very dark, low-contrast engraving where the hound's body is nearly the same tone as the night-sky background, defeating every background-removal technique tried (color threshold, brightness ramp, and rembg all failed to produce a legible cutout). Saved as data/monster_refs/hell-hound/rejected_paget_illustration.jpg
